name: Disasters
description: A world with continents, seas, seasons and disease where every kind of disaster strikes now and then, several at once if it happens that way: ice ages, droughts, meteors, wildfires that spread through thick plants, storms that shove animals and blow soil downwind, floods that drown low ground for a while, volcanoes that burn a crater and leave rich ash, plant blights, outbreaks of a nastier disease and good years. Every one is written to the timeline. Switch the map to Disasters to see fires, floods, storms and volcanic ground as they happen.
